newsitem.title: USA: Elek-Tek to buy microcomputer distributor.
newsitem.headline: Elek-Tek to buy microcomputer distributor.

text.p: Elek-Tek Inc said Tuesday it signed an agreement in principle to acquire Computability Ltd for a combination of cash and stock.

Computability, based in Milwaukee, Wis., is a nationwide mail order provider and catalog reseller of microcomputer products. Computability generated 1996 revenues of approximately $60 million, Elek-Tek said.

"The acquisition of Computability will enable Elek-Tek to significantly raise its national profile in the catalog/mail order business," Richard Rodriguez, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Elek-Tek is a full-line marketer of major brand microcomputer products.
